description: Create a new IAM group. Groups have no description field in the Ncloud API — use tags instead. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the group

groupDescription.description: ⚠️ Ignored — the Ncloud createGroup API has no description field, so this value is NOT sent. Kept only for backward compatibility; use tags to annotate a group

groupName.description: Name for the new group (3-30 chars: Korean/Japanese/English letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'; must start with a letter)

tags.description: Tags as a key-value map, max 20 per resource. Example: {"env":"dev","team":"a"}

name: ncloud_create_group
